robots.body:
# robots.txt — redo.com

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# /search is another app's (the brand experience, behind the router). Its
# search page is blocked exactly, not as a prefix, and everything under it
# but three things the product pages show:
#   /search/img/      the home page's product images
#   /search/product/  the demos the product pages embed
#   /search/embed/    the embeds themselves, so Google can render them
# Under /search/embed/, an asset path one level down or more is blocked:
# the embeds load ./assets/ relatively and the app answers any path with a
# page, so each fake page links a deeper one (assets/assets/...). A crawl
# found 2,850 of them on 2026-10-29 (SEO-18); the real assets sit at
# /search/embed/assets/ and stay allowed. Remove that line once the app
# 404s unknown paths. /search/brands/* is blocked: a canvas is made for any
# domain typed in, so it has no fixed set. Google takes the longest rule
# that matches, which is what lets an Allow inside a Disallow win.
Disallow: /search$
Disallow: /search?
Disallow: /search/
Allow: /search/img/
Allow: /search/product/
Allow: /search/embed/
Disallow: /search/embed/*/assets/

# --- Sitemaps ---
# 1. Every other page on redo.com, built by redo-site from what each route
#    serves (src/pages/sitemap.xml.ts, 2026-10-20).
Sitemap: https://redo.com/sitemap.xml

# 2. The articles: the index, its categories and every guide. At
#    /resources/articles/sitemap.xml until 2026-10-20, which redirects here.
#    The old /resources/sitemap.xml listed /products/chargebacks/*, which
#    are in sitemap 1 now.
Sitemap: https://redo.com/articles/sitemap.xml

llms.body:
# Redo

> Redo is one platform for ecommerce brands to market, sell, ship, and return.

Redo's products come in four groups: Marketing (email and SMS, AI sales and support, a conversational sales agent, cart recovery, visitor identification), Payments (checkout optimization, HSA/FSA payments, chargebacks), Shipping (fulfillment, order editing, cross-border, inventory), and Returns (returns and claims, warranties, international and managed returns). Each product below links to its page on redo.com.

## Marketing

- [Commerce Agent](https://redo.com/products/commerce-agent): a conversational commerce and AI sales agent by text. Starts the conversation, answers the question, finds the product, builds the cart, tracks the shipment, and processes the exchange.
- [Contextual](https://redo.com/products/contextual): identifies anonymous website visitors and writes the enriched events into Klaviyo, Attentive, or Redo Email & SMS, with flows that send only when your native flow didn't.
- [Order Tracking](https://redo.com/products/order-tracking): Shopify order tracking and a branded tracking page for your recent purchasers.
- [Recover](https://redo.com/products/recover): abandoned cart recovery by text, with trained live agents who have real conversations with your shoppers.
- [Email & SMS](https://redo.com/products/email-sms): an email and SMS marketing platform for Shopify, with persona-based marketing and interactive elements.
- [AI Sales & Support](https://redo.com/products/ai-sales-support): AI customer service software for ecommerce: a consolidated support dashboard with AI post-purchase, and a 1:1 sales agent.

## Payments

- [HSA/FSA](https://redo.com/products/hsa-fsa): accept HSA and FSA payments inside your own Shopify checkout. Redo handles eligibility, SIGIS listing, clinical letters, and shopper support.
- [Checkout Optimization](https://redo.com/products/checkout-optimization): checkout optimization software for Shopify, for conversion rate and profit per checkout.
- [Chargebacks](https://redo.com/products/chargebacks): chargeback management across the dispute lifecycle. Resolve prevents avoidable disputes, Alerts catch them as they form, and Reclaim fights the ones that land.

## Shipping

- [Shipping & Fulfillment](https://redo.com/products/shipping-fulfillment): ecommerce shipping and fulfillment software that removes manual steps from pick, pack and ship.
- [Order Editing](https://redo.com/products/order-editing): free order editing for Shopify. Shoppers update orders after purchase, with fewer support tickets and fulfillment kept in sync.
- [Cross Border](https://redo.com/products/cross-border): cross-border ecommerce with landed cost and DDP shipping: accurate duties and taxes at checkout, and duty and tax remittance handled.
- [Inventory Management](https://redo.com/products/inventory-management): Shopify inventory management with AI forecasting, to predict demand and right-size every purchase order.

## Returns

- [Returns & Claims](https://redo.com/products/returns): an AI-driven, automated returns and claims portal for Shopify that turns refunds into exchanges.
- [Warranties](https://redo.com/products/warranties): warranty management and registration software, which also builds customer lists from in-store and marketplace purchases.
- [International Returns](https://redo.com/products/international-returns): international returns management, with warehouses in your main markets and carrier rates and clearance in the rest, inside the returns app 5,000+ brands already run.
- [Managed Returns](https://redo.com/products/managed-returns): returns processing and reverse logistics. Redo receives, inspects, and grades every return at its facilities in three business days or less.

## More

- [Pricing](https://redo.com/pricing): Redo's plans and pricing.
- [Integrations](https://redo.com/integrations): Redo connects with Shopify, WooCommerce, and 100+ ecommerce tools.
- [Guides](https://redo.com/articles): guides and explainers from the Redo team on post-purchase ecommerce: returns, order editing, chargebacks, Shopify.
- [Blog](https://redo.com/blog): insights on ecommerce returns, fulfillment, AI, and the post-purchase experience for growing DTC brands.
